question: Karpaty sa tiahnu oblúkom cez niekoľko krajín až hlboko do Rumunska. Ako sa volá najvyšší vrch celého tohto pohoria?
source_excerpt: Gerlachovský štít is a mountain in the High Tatras and the highest peak in the Carpathian Mountains, Slovakia and Poland's neighbouring region.

extra.why_interesting: Slovaks know Gerlach as their highest mountain, but most assume the huge Romanian Carpathians must be higher. The question makes them realise the whole range peaks at home, and they can reason their way to it.
extra.verification_notes: Gerlachovský štít at 2655 m is the highest peak of the entire Carpathians; Moldoveanu (2544 m) is only the highest in Romania (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gerlachovský_štít).

explanation: Hoci rumunské Karpaty sú oveľa rozsiahlejšie, najvyššie miesto celého oblúka je u nás v Tatrách. Gerlach má takmer 2 655 metrov a prekonáva všetky vrcholy od Česka až po Rumunsko.

question: Najväčší riečny ostrov v Európe leží na Slovensku. Obteká ho Dunaj a Malý Dunaj. Ako sa volá?
source_excerpt: Žitný ostrov is the largest river island in Europe, lying between the Danube, its tributary Little Danube and Váh.

extra.why_interesting: Players drive across it without ever feeling they are on an island, since it is flat farmland with towns like Dunajská Streda. Learning that it holds a European record is a real 'huh, really?' moment, and the clue about the two Danube branches lets them work it out.
extra.verification_notes: Žitný ostrov is widely documented as the largest river island in Europe, between the Danube and Little Danube (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C5%BDitn%C3%BD_ostrov).

explanation: Kto ide z Bratislavy do Komárna, celý čas je vlastne na ostrove, len o tom nevie. Žitný ostrov je taký veľký, že sú na ňom celé mestá vrátane Dunajskej Stredy a Veľkého Medera.
